english.title: Fail to surrender driver qualification / national driver qualification card - Vehicle Drivers ( CPC ) Regulations 2007

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Vehicle Drivers Certificates of Professional Competence Regulations 2007

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a driver qualification card or national driver qualification card, without reasonable excuse, failed to surrender the card to the Secretary of State as soon as reasonably practicable, when the name of the holder of the card as specified on that card ceased to be correct
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(6) and (9) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.

english.notes:
(i) These regulations apply to persons driving a bus on or after 10th September 2008 or driving a lorry on or after 10th September 2009.
(ii) This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant being the holder of a driver qualification card or national driver qualification card, without reasonable excuse, failed to surrender the card to the Secretary of State as soon as reasonably practicable, when the name of the holder of the card as specified on that card ceased to be correct.
